notes.author: teddy0@arch-aftershock-rapid-glass-S267454
notes.content:
Follow-up to bd-01x / gh-79. Maintainer asked (2026-08-27) for this to be FILED ONLY, not implemented in that session.

gh-79 = read path (make annots visible). This = write path (create/edit/delete, save back), i.e. what Okular does.

Blocked on machinery kopitiam-pdf does not have at all:
  * Object serialisation + an incremental-update writer (append changed objects,
    new xref section, trailer with /Prev). Bulk of the work; useful far beyond
    annotations and probably deserves its own bead once sized.
  * A mutable object model -- PdfDocument is read-only today; annots come out as
    cloned Objects with no identity back to the xref slot.
  * Appearance resynthesis on edit (upstream: pdf_annot_needs_resynthesis).

Upstream to port (vendored 5fe54ce, reuse the pin per AID-0056, do not re-check):
  pdf-annot.c:951 pdf_create_annot, :641 pdf_create_annot_raw, :1112 pdf_delete_annot
  pdf-annot.c:3416 pdf_set_annot_ink_list, :3544 pdf_add_annot_ink_list
  pdf-annot.c:2632 pdf_set_annot_color, :2027 pdf_set_annot_border_width,
                   :1326 pdf_set_annot_rect, :1374 pdf_set_annot_contents
  pdf-annot.c:475 pdf_annot_needs_resynthesis, :504 pdf_dirty_annot
  pdf-write.c incremental-update path -- NOT yet surveyed

Reuse annot_appearance::synthesize_ap from gh-79 rather than duplicating it.

Hard requirement: output must be readable by OTHER viewers (Okular, poppler,
Acrobat), not just by us. An incremental update our parser accepts but poppler
rejects is silent data loss on somebody's annotated document. Cross-viewer
round-trip verification is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.

When WRITING, always emit a real /AP even though we can synthesise on read --
AP-less output is exactly what made gh-79 hard, and hayro renders nothing
without it.

notes.author: teddy0@arch-aftershock-rapid-glass-S267454
notes.content:
UPSTREAM WRITE PATH EXISTS -- this is a port, not from-scratch (checked vendor 5fe54ce):
  pdf-write.c            pdf_save_document / pdf_write_document (90KB)
  document.h:790         do_incremental -- 'Write just the changed objects', FIRST-CLASS upstream option
  pdf-write.c:2101       incremental parsed from write options
  pdf-write.c:1248       writeobject
  pdf-object.c:3268      fmt_obj  (:3415 fmt_str, :3450 fmt_name -- the ESCAPING; this is the
                         cross-reader compatibility bar. Port it, do not hand-roll format!.)
  document.h:870         pdf_can_be_saved_incrementally

CONSTRAINT: pdf_can_be_saved_incrementally is FALSE for a repaired document (or applied
redactions). Not live today (our xref loader errors instead of repairing) but it will
collide with any future repair work -- the two must agree on annotating a damaged file.

Only the incremental subset is needed. pdf-write.c also does GC, objstm repacking,
encryption and linearisation -- all out of scope.

title: kopitiam-pdf: annotation authoring -- create/edit/delete annots and write them back
